scores.notes: Both show a circular pit lined with pale stone courses, lions below and palms above the rim; the upper courtyard view is compatible with the view from inside.
Peter has the same short curly dark hair with gray at the temples, graying full beard, prominent nose and mature face in the courtyard and stepping from the boat.
Both show a low wooden open sailing boat on dark, foaming water with a hilly settled shoreline; mast, ropes and plank construction are compatible.
The open wooden hull, single mast and low hilly shoreline with small buildings are compatible. The calmer water and clearing sky fit the described calming moment.
Daniel has close-cropped gray hair, a short gray beard, brown skin and a lean, angular older face in both the pit and court.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor enclosed by blue-green walls of water. The taller close water walls on the left and open desert horizon on the right are compatible with different positions along the passage.
